items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 16 at 3:32AM AKDT until September 16 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels as high as 1.5 to 4.0 feet above the
normal highest tide line.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast, including Kwigillingok,
Kongiganak, Kipnuk, Toksook Bay, and Tununak.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM Today.

* IMPACTS...Coastal flooding of low lying areas and erosion are
possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Conditions will gradually improve through
today as southwest winds and southwest fetch along the coast
come down further.
items.areas: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island
items.instruction:
A coastal flood advisory indicates that onshore winds and tides
will combine to generate flooding of low areas along the shore.
